title: Wonders of Switzerland and Paris | Glitz & Glaciers
highlights: Discover Paris and Zurich—iconic landmarks, world-class art, dreamy riversides, and cultural delights await in these stylish cities.
Experience the refreshing mist and hear the roar of the most powerful waterfall in Europe, the Rhine Falls, during your exhilarating and unforgettable boat ride adventure.
Ride the historic cogwheel railway to the "Queen of the Mountains," Mt. Rigi, offering panoramic views of the Swiss Alps and the breathtaking beauty of Switzerland.
Marvel at the Eiffel Tower, the heart of Paris known for its dazzling lights, historic allure, and sweeping views from 300 meters above.
Enjoy a boat ride on the crystal-clear waters of Lucerne Lake and admire stunning mountain landscapes, creating an unforgettable journey through Switzerland.
overview:
About the tour:
A trip through Switzerland and Paris offers a dreamlike experience. Begin in Zurich, Europe’s financial hub, surrounded by snow-capped Alps and scenic lakes. Discover the charm of Mount Rigi, then head to Lucerne, a city rich in medieval architecture, nestled beside Lake Lucerne. Explore Zurich’s gems, including the majestic Rhine Falls and the Swiss National Museum. Your journey through these stunning destinations will immerse you in natural beauty, history, and the magic of European culture.






Quick Info:
Route: Paris - Zurich
Duration: 6 Nights & 7 Days
Start Point: Charles de Gaulle airport
End Point: Zurich Airport

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Paris | Day at leisure
days.desc: Welcome to the City of Light, Paris! Upon arrival at the Paris International Airport, get driven to your hotel. Check-in and spend your time at leisure. You can explore Montmartre, a hilltop neighborhood known for its bohemian history, art scene, and the stunning Sacré-Cœur Basilica with panoramic city views. You can also discover Rue Montorgueil, a lively street famous for its Parisian cafés, fresh markets, bakeries, and authentic local vibe—perfect for a true taste of Parisian daily life.

days.title: Paris Hop on Hop off Tour | Eiffel Tower 2nd level tickets
days.desc: Kickstart your Paris journey with a scenic hop-on, hop-off bus tour. Cruise past iconic landmarks like the Louvre, Moulin Rouge, Champs-Élysées, and Notre-Dame, while enjoying panoramic city views and informative audio commentary. Hop off and head to the Eiffel Tower. Once there, ascend to the second level for breathtaking views over Paris. Explore the city’s rich history, grand architecture, and artistic culture all in one unforgettable ride.

days.title: Disneyland Paris Tour (Optional Tour)
days.desc: In the morning, you can opt for an escape to Walt Disney World with an optional tour of Disneyland Paris. You can take local transport and reach Disneyland to soak-in the magical atmosphere. Meet your favorite Disney characters, watch the Stars fireworks show, and enjoy thrilling rides. You can explore the Disney Park or the immersive Walt Disney Studios Park, for a unique and unforgettable experience. After a fun-filled day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Zurich
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from your hotel and head to the Paris Gare De Lyon Station to board your train for Zurich, one of the most beautiful cities in Switzerland. Upon arrival at Zürich Hbf Station, use your Swiss pass to take local transport to your hotel & check-in. Then, spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can explore a huge collection of artworks in the Kunsthaus and visit the famous Bahnhofstrasse, a vibrant street in Zurich. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Swiss Continuous Pass - Swiss Continuous Second Class Pass (4 Days)

days.title: Mt Rigi and Lucerne Day Trip with Boat Ride
days.desc: Today, use your Swiss pass and reach Zurich Central bus Station to board the coach for Mt. Rigi. Upon reaching, enjoy a cable car ride followed by a cogwheel train to the top of Mt. Rigi. Take-in the stunning views before descending to Vitznau. Next, enjoy a scenic boat ride on the calming Lake Lucerne surrounded with mountains. Also, you can explore Lucerne on your own before transferring back to Zurich Central Bus Station. From there, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Mt Rigi and Lucerne Day Trip from Zurich With Boat Ride on a Shared basis

days.title: Rhine Falls Boat Trip
days.desc: Today, board a train from Zurich using your Swiss pass to reach Schaffhausenuse and witness Europe’s biggest waterfall, the Rhine Falls. Enjoy a boat ride to get close to the waterfall and feel the mist, while enjoying stunning views of the cascading water. Post-tour, you can explore Zurich and visit the Swiss National Museum, the famous FIFA Museum, and many more attractions with your Swiss pass for discounts. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Farewell Switzerland – Departure from Zurich
days.desc: It’s time to say goodbye to the land of mountains, chocolate, and unforgettable memories. Check out and transfer to Zurich Airport for your onward journey, carrying with you the timeless beauty and tranquility of Switzerland in your heart.
